purpose: Canonical structured data for the media outreach stream — podcasts, YouTube channels, journalists, PR agencies. Every other view (register section, pitch lists, any future media page) generates from this file. If a media fact is about to be typed anywhere else, move it here first.

segments.podcast: Animation / AI-art / design podcasts. Pitch = guest one-liner + talking points.
segments.youtube: Channels covering animation tooling and AI art. Filter on subscribers and upload cadence.
segments.journalist: Named bylines at the outlets rivals appear in. Pitch = a story, not a guest.
segments.pr_agency: Cost money — flag for Otto, never pitch.

hooks.hybrid-craftsman: 20 years of traditional craft + generative AI in production, while the industry argument is loud and fact-free
hooks.conferences-guide: top-3 Google ranking guide to animation conferences — useful to any host's audience
hooks.public-art-oddity: topiary / robotics / sensory gardens for general-interest formats

field_notes.why_fit: The episode or article that proves this contact covers the territory. A contact with no evidence never leaves 'sourced'.
field_notes.relevance: 1-3 set at qualification. 3 = has covered this exact territory; 2 = adjacent; 1 = long shot.
field_notes.verified: Date the contact details were last checked against a live page. Null means never.
field_notes.person: Null until a sourcing pass finds the actual byline/host. Never guess a name or invent an email pattern.
